lm-all-all.header: Warner Records Store · Storefront: All · Channel: All · Category: All · Sep 1 – Sep 30, 2026
lm-all-all.transcript:
Here's the Warner Records Store recap for September twenty twenty-six. We're looking at all storefronts, every channel, and every category. These sales numbers are demo data, not the live store. The product ideas at the end come from public artist catalogs.

Net revenue came in at about one point three million dollars. That's about twenty-seven thousand orders, and the average order was about forty-eight dollars. Conversion was two point nine percent. About fifty-four percent of orders were from new customers. Returns took three point one percent of revenue.

Versus the previous period, revenue was up about ten percent. Versus last year, it was up about twenty-one percent.

Signed and Store Exclusives led the category gains, and Box Sets and Deluxe was the soft spot. Organic Social was the strongest channel move. SMS was the softest.

Organic search brought in about one hundred forty-four thousand dollars. Organic social was led by TikTok, at about fifty-eight thousand dollars.

Paid media spent about one hundred ninety thousand dollars and returned about three point six times that. Google Brand Search was the strongest campaign. TikTok TopView was the weakest. I'd test moving about half of that weak spend toward Retargeting.

Email and text brought in about five hundred thirty-six thousand dollars, up about thirty percent from the previous period. Amazon added about two hundred seventy-three thousand dollars, and fees took about one hundred thousand dollars. Amazon US led the marketplaces.

The top seller was The Great American Bar Scene 2LP by Zach Bryan. Watch stock on Christmas (Red Vinyl). It's close to selling out.

The next ninety days are forecast at about five point five million dollars. The peak lines up with Black Friday + RSD.

On the public catalogs, Zach Bryan is a good place to start. Offer signed/autographed physical (vinyl/CD or signed insert) For social, I'd put the next sprint on TikTok. That's the recap. The tables are in the email if you want every row.
